blockers.title: D-002 defers DR-106 WHOLLY by recorded disposition; the artifact asserts there is no recorded deferral and calls the slice authoritative
detail: The artifact states: 'D-002's first slice is Trusted TypeScript analysis — CLI-first, offline, contained. That is an authoritative offline analysis profile. This artifact does not treat D-002 as a recorded deferral of DR-106.' authorityClaim and whatThisDoesNotDo repeat the same position as 'does not treat D-002 as a silent deferral of this row'.

COORD line 418, inside the D-002 entry, reads: 'Authoritative sealed closure, replay, and evidence custody are OUT of slice 1, and — correcting the previous draft's unlawful row splits (turn-1 MF-03) — DR-106, DR-109 and DR-113 are deferred WHOLLY'. Both phrases are bolded in the source. The entry gives its reasoning: 'their acceptance-evidence cells all begin with applied DR-002..008 successors'.

COORD line 414, four lines earlier in the same entry, states the slice's 'State: local, non-authoritative only — rebuildable cache/index and operational metadata classes (DR-124), plus doctor/purge honesty (DR-G12).' The artifact's classification of the slice as 'an authoritative offline analysis profile' is the direct negation of what D-002 records about itself.

The deferral is not a single stray sentence. COORD records it five times: line 252 'Inherit-blocked: DR-106, DR-109, DR-113, DR-124'; line 418 as quoted; line 442 'DR-106, DR-109, DR-113, each deferred WHOLLY (T2-01: the previous "halves" wording here contradicted the entry's own MF-03 withdrawal and is struck)'; line 461 'DR-106, DR-109, DR-113: deferred wholly (MF-03), closing via the condition-1 chain; their design enters a later slice'; and line 499 'the unlawful DR-106/109/113 splits withdrawn (deferred wholly)'. I read each and found no later entry reinstating DR-106 into slice 1.

The framing that rescues the claim — that this would be a *silent* deferral — is unavailable. A deferral stated in bold, by row identifier, with reasoning, corrected across two turns, and repeated in five places is the paradigm of a recorded one.

The artifact is contradicted by the very clause it carries verbatim. storageMandateTextCarriedVerbatim reproduces file 04 lines 59-64: 'An install whose analysis surfaces are declared non-authoritative — the management-only core install, or a slice whose recorded scope disposition defers authoritative closure (see the central register's first-slice dispositions) — defers storage mechanics by that recorded disposition, never silently.' That sentence exists precisely to license what D-002 did. The artifact extracts it correctly and then reasons as though its second limb has no instance.
blockers.notADriftArtifact: The deferral text sits at byte offset 24573 of COORD, well inside the artifact's own pinned 243405-byte snapshot at 0833973f…. The artifact pinned a snapshot that contains, five times, the recorded deferral it says does not exist. The dispatch's PASS-NO-SCOPE-EFFECT rule for append-only drift does not reach this.
blockers.whyBlockerGrade: This is a false statement about a governing source, it is load-bearing for the row's standing against the first slice, and it is the single claim the dispatch put up for verification ('D-002 first slice is not a silent deferral of this row'). It also inverts the meaning of the architecture clause the artifact itself extracts, so the error is internal as well as external.
blockers.directionOfError: The error runs strict, not permissive: the artifact asserts DR-106 is a live hard blocker for a slice that explicitly deferred it, rather than relieving an obligation. It grants nothing, mints nothing, and SATISFIES nothing. But 'do not treat D-002 as a silent deferral' cuts both ways — denying a deferral that was properly recorded misstates the register's relationship to the first slice just as a silent deferral would.
blockers.minimumRepair: Replace the d002FirstSlice paragraph with what D-002 records: the first slice declares its state local and non-authoritative only, places authoritative sealed closure out of slice 1, and defers DR-106 WHOLLY by recorded disposition, which is the lawful second limb of the file 04 clause rather than a silent deferral. Keep the honest residue — that the deferral is scoped to slice 1, that DR-106 stays OPEN / inherits hard blockers per the live row, and that a later slice must close it. Retain the existing disclaimers that this is neither a D-096 (A) grant nor a SATISFIED mark. Drop the 'That is an authoritative offline analysis profile' sentence, which no source supports.
